intent: Give RunnerUp runs a self-hosted dashboard (Endurain) fed over WebDAV from the phone, without touching the adb-based workout gate that unlocks the PC.
scope: endurain/ - compose, setup and publish scripts, systemd units, README
python_pkg/endurain_import/ - importer package and its tests
~/.config/dufs/dufs.yaml - one added scoped auth entry (not in this repo)
~/gitea/sites/endurain.caddy - new edge site (not in this repo)
changes: docker-compose.yml pinned to codeberg.org (the GitHub repo is a stale read-only mirror at v0.17.7 vs v0.19.0), bound to 127.0.0.1:8085 so the LAN cannot reach it unfronted, redis renamed endurain-redis to avoid a container name collision

postgres volume mounted at /var/lib/postgresql/18/docker instead of upstream's pre-18 /var/lib/postgresql/data; upstream's example fails as an unexplained 'container is unhealthy' because mounting over that path leaves it root-owned
setup_endurain.sh generates secrets, chowns each bind mount to the uid its own image runs as (1000 app, 999 postgres, 999 redis), and gates on the seeded admin/admin login
publish_endurain.sh installs the Caddy site only after that gate passes, and validates the config before reloading so a bad snippet cannot take down gitea/cloud/website

importer dedupes on TWO axes: a SHA-256 content hash, and an activity key that collapses the .gpx/.tcx pair RunnerUp writes for one run (different bytes, same run) and strips the device model RunnerUp's WebDAV names embed

ambiguous upload outcomes (5xx/timeout) are never re-queued to bulk_import, because Endurain has no duplicate detection and the activity may already be committed; only definite 4xx rejections are staged
second dufs auth entry scoped to /RunnerUp so the phone credential cannot read Keepass or gdrive_backups; setup_dufs_cloud.sh patched to preserve it across re-runs

verification.evidence: ruff, ruff format, mypy, pylint, bandit, pytest-with-coverage, shellcheck, leaked-secrets and python_pkg-location hooks all Passed
52 passed; 100% branch coverage on all 5 modules
first run: 4 imported, 1 already known (the .gpx twin correctly skipped); re-run: 0 imported, 5 already known; DB count stayed 4 with no duplicate start_times
HTTP 200, ssl_verify_result=0, issuer Let's Encrypt; gitea/cloud/dice on the same edge still 200/401/200
207 on /RunnerUp, PUT 201, 403 on /Keepass and on a direct Keepass file GET; root PROPFIND lists only / and /RunnerUp
1090 passed, 100% coverage; _runnerup_*.py unmodified per git status; all 5 phone files intact after the adb pulls

risks: RunnerUp has NO background sync (no WorkManager/JobScheduler/AlarmManager anywhere in its source), so every upload needs a manual tap after a run. Not fixable without patching the app.
The ledger JSON is the only thing preventing duplicates; deleting it and re-importing WILL duplicate every activity, since Endurain does not deduplicate.
Endurain's OpenAPI schema mislabels the API-key header as X-Client-Type; the working header is X-API-Key, established empirically. A future version could change this.
The service is now internet-reachable. Its admin password is the only thing protecting it, and Endurain seeds admin/admin with no env override on a fresh database.
rollback: rm ~/gitea/sites/endurain.caddy && docker exec gitea-caddy caddy reload --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile   # unpublishes immediately
docker compose -f endurain/docker-compose.yml down; sudo rm -rf /var/opt/endurain   # destroys all imported activities
Remove the runnerup line from ~/.config/dufs/dufs.yaml and restart dufs
After rollback, confirm screen-locker still verifies a workout: pytest screen_locker/tests -k runnerup
